text: Never put Stack.useSync on a single resource prop field (e.g. domain: Stack.useSync(...)). Alchemy Plan.resolveInput does not unwrap nested Effects, so the Effect object is sent to Cloudflare as hostname and deploy fails with SchemaError. Wrap the entire props object: Worker(id, Stack.useSync(({ stage }) => ({ ... })), impl).
prescription: Wrap entire InputProps object in Stack.useSync; set domain: stage === "prod" ? HOST : undefined inside.

text: Cloudflare Worker + SPA assets must set runWorkerFirst for /api/* (and /ingest). Without it, notFoundHandling single-page-application serves index.html for Better Auth callbacks; AuthBoundary then redirects to /auth?next=/api/auth/callback/google?code=… and OAuth never completes.
Bound streaming persistence and diagnostic writes with an explicit per-generation operation budget; reserve terminal-state capacity before optional replay data.
Do not replace client-generated chat message IDs during persistence; preserve validated incoming IDs so retry, edit, and branch operations address the stored message.
Never deploy a Worker that references new tables until its generated D1 migration has been applied and verified in production.
When deleting the active chat, finish the route redirect before broadcasting the sidebar refresh so the UI cannot retain a deleted conversation.
Avoid duplicating generic application source as string templates. Keep canonical files in generic fixtures; generator must materialize them with explicit configuration substitutions.
Avoid coupled chat session transitions implemented as multiple independent React state setters. Model session state and transitions in one reducer or state machine.
Avoid chat lifecycle state in React reducers; model durable chat transitions with an explicit XState machine exported from @emi/core/web.
Never emit a request event as the success event for an actor operation; use a distinct typed completion event so parent routing cannot repeat the request.
Never render external or persisted URLs directly into href or src; route every sink through an allow-list policy appropriate to the URL and media type.
Never spread caller-controlled transport body fields after transport-owned identifiers or mode flags; reserve protected keys at the boundary.
Every replaceable async actor query must carry an operation identity and ignore stale success or failure before mutating parent state.
Keep each actor-owned side effect on one routed path; do not retain a dead duplicate callback or direct action for the same operation.
Admit a durable chat generation before persisting its incoming user turn, or make both operations one rollback-safe transaction; never leave admission races with orphan turns.
Keep product-domain HTTP contracts out of @emi/core; generic core exports only foundational contracts and flavor packages compose product APIs over CoreApi.
